decisions.documented_root_cause: Missed handoffs were tied to missing client inputs at the time work was due, compounded by a structural gap: no shared checklist for handoff expectations and a concurrent-escalation cap of three that may have prevented Nora from absorbing additional escalations when inputs arrived late. The advance-notice accommodation requirement was also not met for today's review, requiring a compliant rescheduled process before any formal action.

commitments.detail: Reschedule the performance-review discussion with a written agenda provided at least two business days in advance, per Nora's approved accommodation.
Create a single shared checklist for handoff expectations that defines what client inputs are required, who provides them, and by when, so handoff readiness is unambiguous.

Ensure Nora's concurrent client escalations do not exceed her approved accommodation cap of three, and build escalation-overflow coverage into the support plan so missing-input situations are not compounded by the cap.
Formalize Nora's informal offer to serve as a peer feedback partner for four weeks as part of the support plan, pending the rescheduled compliant review.

No formal performance warning will be issued today. The decision on whether a formal warning is warranted will be made at the rescheduled review after the advance-notice requirement is met and all accommodation and workload factors are formally weighed.
